title: Join a list with a StringBuilder

blocks.text: Each `+=` on a String inside a loop builds a whole new String. A `StringBuilder` is appended to in place, and turned into one String at the end. The page's own loop leaves a trailing `", "` behind; this one must not.
Write `join(List<String> items)` in `Csv`. It returns the items separated by `", "`:

items: one item has no separator: `join(List.of("solo"))` is `"solo"`;

cases.says: The items come out in order, separated by ", ".
"a, b, c" has no ", " after its last item.

concepts: Strings joined in a loop are appended to one StringBuilder, and a separator goes only between items.
